answer.original_source: Wendell Weeks, Corning Chairman, CEO and President, quoted by Fox News Digital
answer.new_information: Weeks said Corning was in its fastest growth period and would probably double its size over the coming years; almost all new hires would be in advanced manufacturing, with a significant part in the United States. The period is only described as “the coming years,” and “size” is not defined. This is a Corning management forecast, not a reported result or a new NVIDIA investment judgement. The article’s separate account of the Corning-NVIDIA facilities does not make this forecast a claim about NVIDIA.
